newsitem.title: USA: US CREDIT OUTLOOK - Looking past claims, Fed minutes.
newsitem.headline: US CREDIT OUTLOOK - Looking past claims, Fed minutes.

text.p: U.S. fixed income markets will take a passing interest in weekly jobless claims data and the transcripts from the March Federal Open Market Committee meeting on Thursday, analysts said.
But traders said they are already looking ahead to key data two weeks from now to make a more informed judgment on the Fed's decision to hold rates steady on Tuesday.
"We had the big event yesterday, which turned out to be a bigger event today than it was yesterday," said Mead Briggs, proprietary trading manager at Credit Suisse First Boston.
